trigger: an unresponsive offline-hive mount (e.g. a dead network share) during the retry's Phase B
summary: The retry invokes the deadline-less default hive guard from TAR's single-threaded interval-trigger dispatch; a hang would permanently wedge all five of TAR's triggers including retention, with no self-recovery, and block clean shutdown.
classification_rationale: the original build's own risk framing ('a one-shot risk at init()') did not account for the retry's recurring, same-thread reach
adjudication_rationale: put to the user as a three-way choice (disclose+defer / build the real fix now / narrow the retry's reach); directed to build the real fix rather than defer

trigger: an enterprise customer upgrading while running an affected plugin against a non-standard profile root
summary: This diff's fail-closed behaviour tightening (a previously-silent mount now surfacing as a named constraint) had no upgrade note, against this repo's own established convention for an equivalent class of change (a prior governance run blocked the same gap on a different PR).
classification_rationale: a breaking/security-relevant behaviour change with no required doc, per the policy's own closed six-item list

trigger: many simultaneously-permanently-hung profile mounts across the whole agent process, not just this call site
summary: bounded_call_ex's outstanding-call ceiling (64 slots) is process-wide, shared with every other plugin consumer; a pathological fleet state could exhaust it via this one call site, degrading unrelated plugins -- strictly better than the pre-fix state (one hang wedging the whole TAR dispatch thread forever) and not fixed further.
classification_rationale: a disclosed, accepted residual of reusing the shared primitive, recorded for completeness

summary: sre's Gate 8 re-check confirms SRE-1 CLOSED for the exact mechanism identified (the trigger-engine's single worker thread now bounds at ~30s regardless of how long the underlying mount hangs), with two disclosed non-blocking capacity notes (more abandoned threads can accumulate over the 6-day retry window than before; no per-batch cap on simultaneously-stuck profiles).
classification_rationale: closure confirmation, recorded per the governance ledger's own requirement to record what was found and how closure was verified

trigger: a future refactor silently breaking the one-line call-site wiring in autoruns/installed_apps/license_scan
summary: No persisted test exercises autoruns/installed_apps/license_scan's real production call site under a forced hive refusal -- only the new pure helper functions are unit-tested directly. Re-confirmed MEDIUM/deferred by code-review, adversarial-review (Kimi+Codex cross-examined), and this governance run's enterprise-readiness and security-guardian passes.
classification_rationale: a bounded-blast-radius missing test, SHOULD per the policy floor's own carve-out, not a floor

policy_floor: ownership/lifetime defect: an unjoined, ambiguously-owned thread running plugin code that the agent can unmap (cpp-safety blocking contract)
trigger: a hive mount that outlives its 30 s bound while the agent stops and unloads the TAR module
classification_rationale: the unjoined thread runs plugin code after the owner's bounded wait; derived MEDIUM (I5, E5: a >30 s hang plus a stop in the window, impact a crash at shutdown), gated by the lifetime policy floor; nobody forced the scenario
summary: enum_registry_outbound_history abandons the bounded mount thread on TimedOut; the thread keeps running TAR code, TarPlugin::shutdown neither tracks nor waits for it, and the agent teardown dlcloses/FreeLibraries the plugin. Fixed in 84e409f4b: the first timeout pins the plugin module (GetModuleHandleExW with PIN, on every timeout; pinning again is harmless) and stops the walk. Accepted residuals, recorded here: the DLL stays loaded until process exit; the stuck thread holds the process-wide offline-hive mutex and leaves SeBackup/SeRestore enabled until the mount returns; it occupies one of the primitive's 64 slots. The banner no longer cites dism_bounded_call.hpp as its pattern (that header keeps its work in agent-core). Chosen with Alex over moving the mount into agent-core (a redesign) and over a recorded acceptance.

trigger: one hung offline profile in the walk
classification_rationale: correctness of the retry accounting; the walk's wait is no longer 30 s per profile
summary: After one timeout every later offline profile queued behind the stuck mount (it holds the offline-hive mutex), timed out in turn and was charged an attempt it never made; a Rejected call (fn never ran) was charged too. Fixed in 84e409f4b: decide_mount_call stops the walk after the first TimedOut or Rejected, the remaining profiles carry attempted=false, which apply_outcomes retains without a bump, and the first pass still seeds them so they are retried, not lost.

trigger: a pathological hive with 4096+ UNC artifacts
classification_rationale: code contradicted the documented attempt budget
summary: apply_outcomes retained a cap-cut read unchanged, so the profile retried forever against the 'total number of acquisitions' contract in the README and banner. Codex graded this HIGH (I5(b)); the reviewer MEDIUM, since the rule needs persistent work on a path shared with revocation, enforcement, audit or retention and this is one short daily read. Fixed in 84e409f4b: a cap-cut read is an attempt like any other and is abandoned at the maximum (token row_cap).

trigger: an access-denied open of one MountPoints2 child key
summary: The child open's result was discarded, unlike leg (a), so a row with a lost timestamp read as a clean read. Fixed in 84e409f4b: note_failure.

trigger: a pending SID that leaves the profile list
summary: A vanished pending SID was dropped with no log line. Fixed in 84e409f4b: one info line per SID.

trigger: a ProfileList key carrying a pipe or newline (needs local admin)
classification_rationale: wire-format forging by a local administrator; cosmetic to the consumer, derived LOW
summary: report_hive_file_refused only used sanitize_utf8, so a crafted key could forge columns. Fixed in 84e409f4b: sanitize_utf8 then safe_output_field on the sid and the token separately, with a test.

trigger: the first-pass commit fails after the rows were inserted, then the agent restarts
summary: The first pass inserted without a duplicate check, so a restart after a failed config commit wrote the same historical rows again. Fixed in 84e409f4b: the first pass uses skip_known_historical, as the retry insert already does.
